patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-quality photography is used as dominant visual elements for sections, often paired with text overlays or content blocks.
Content sections frequently alternate between a dark background with light text and a light background with dark text, creating strong visual contrast.
Headings and key labels often use a bold, condensed sans-serif in all caps, providing a strong, authoritative voice.
A high-contrast palette of deep charcoal, bright white, and vibrant red/yellow accents is used to highlight key information and calls to action.
Sections reveal with a subtle fade-up and slight slide-up animation as they enter the viewport, creating a dynamic scrolling experience.
The initial hero image features a subtle parallax scrolling effect, where the background image moves slower than the foreground content.

technique_notes: The site uses a scroll-triggered animation system (likely locomotive-scroll as hinted) to create a dynamic experience. This includes a subtle parallax effect on the hero image and staggered fade-up/slide-up animations for content sections as they scroll into view.
Full-bleed, high-resolution photography is used extensively, often with a subtle dark overlay or placed against high-contrast background colors to ensure text readability.
Grid layouts are employed for product displays and feature sections, allowing for organized presentation of multiple items while maintaining visual balance.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold, often uppercase display headings (~3-4x body) are paired with smaller, lighter body text and compact uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, from buttons to image containers, conveying a modern and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical padding between main sections and within the hero, while product grids maintain a balanced density.

standout: The site's distinctive blend of a high-contrast, almost stark color palette with rich, editorial-quality food photography creates a luxurious yet bold brand identity. The subtle scroll-triggered animations enhance the premium feel without distracting from the content, making the site feel both modern and sophisticated.
